cards.title: Bank cards
cards.intro: Discover our secure bank cards, designed to give you freedom and peace of mind every day. Whether you're looking for a card for everyday purchases, travel abroad, or deferred payment options, FINA LCL has the right solution for you.
cards.feature1: Enhanced security: EMV chip technology, real-time SMS alerts, spending limit control.
cards.feature2: Accessibility: classic, gold or premium cards depending on your profile.
cards.feature3: Contactless payment: for more speed and flexibility.
cards.feature4: Included insurance: travel insurance, purchase protection, 24/7 assistance.
cards.manageApp: Easily manage your cards through our intuitive mobile app.
cards.formTitle: Choose the bank card that suits you
cards.formSubtitle: Select the type of card you need — classic, gold or premium — and fill in the form below. We'll contact you shortly to finalise your request.
cards.confirmation: Your card request has been sent. We will contact you shortly.

accounts.title: Current and savings accounts
accounts.intro: At FINA LCL, managing your money becomes simple and flexible with our current and savings account offers.
accounts.feature1: Current accounts: suitable for both individuals and professionals, with instant transfers, direct debits, chequebooks and online statements.
accounts.feature2: Savings accounts: personalised solutions to save money according to your goals (savings books, term deposits, savings plans).
accounts.feature3: Flexibility: online account opening, simplified withdrawal and deposit options.
accounts.feature4: Personalised support: our advisors are here to help you optimise your finances.
accounts.openAccountTitle: Open your FINA LCL current account in a few clicks
accounts.openAccountText: Fill in the form below with your personal information, upload your supporting documents, and receive your contract by email within 48h.
accounts.blockedText: With a locked (term) account, you agree not to withdraw your savings before the chosen duration ends, in exchange for a better interest rate than free savings. The longer the lock period, the better the rate.
accounts.confirmation: Your account opening request has been sent.
accounts.savingsTitle: Simulate your savings and grow your capital
accounts.savingsText: Set your savings goals and estimate your potential returns based on your options (duration, monthly amount, interest rate).

investments.expertText: Our investment experts advise you at every stage of your project, from drafting your business plan to its evaluation.
investments.marketText: Discover the stock market: your money should work for you rather than sit idle in a bank account.
investments.feature1: Personalised advice: wealth assessment, tailored investment strategy.
investments.feature2: Diversified financial products: stocks, bonds, mutual funds, SICAV, ETFs.
investments.feature3: Access to stock markets: secure online trading with powerful tools.
investments.feature4: Training and support: webinars, market analysis, exclusive newsletters.
investments.accountFormTitle: Start investing according to your goals
investments.accountFormText: Tell us your preferences and risk profile to get secure access to the stock market and a wide range of financial products.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to your most common questions.

q1.question: What documents are required to apply for a loan?
q1.answer: You will need your ID, proof of address, and your latest payslips or bank statements.

q2.question: How long does loan approval take?
q2.answer: We respond within 24h for personal loans and within 48h for business loans.

q3.question: What interest rates do you offer?
q3.answer: Our rates vary depending on your profile and loan type. Use our simulator to get an estimate.
